boxes.meaning: make something look better than it is

english.note: Use this when a portrayal makes a person, group, or thing seem better or cooler than it really is.

examples.english: The film seems to glorify that villain by making him look like a hero.
examples.traditional: 套戲將嗰個反派美化到好似英雄咁。
examples.jyutping: tou3 hei3 zoeng1 go2 go3 faan2 paai1 mei5 faa3 dou3 hou2 ci5 jing1 hung4 gam3

english.note: Use 美化 for abstract or public-facing descriptions of improving an image, appearance, or environment.

examples.english: The government says the new road will beautify the whole community.
examples.traditional: 政府話條新路會美化成個社區。
examples.jyutping: zing3 fu2 waa6 tiu4 san1 lou6 wui5 mei5 faa3 sing4 go3 se5 keoi1
